name: manual_3290c3
claim: Enter a Python venv through an exec wrapper and build it from the uv minor-version link: CPython activates a venv only when pyvenv.cfg sits beside or one level above the invoked (undereferenced) executable path, so a symlink to <env>/bin/python3 from another directory runs the bare base interpreter, and uv venv --python 3.13.18 pins pyvenv.cfg home to the patch directory, which dangles once uv removes that patch.
